identityAssociations.locator: Printed pages 2 to 3, archaeological name and approximate Ohio chronology.
identityAssociations.scope: The early imported feature covers the Ohio River region from 500 to 100 BCE. A second feature labelled Adena covers an overlapping region but is assigned 1492 to 1500. Both source leads identify Adena culture. The association supplies one explanatory narrative while explicitly rejecting the second record’s chronology, not validating its geometry.
identityAssociations.geometryCheck: Both bounding boxes inspected; precise extents unchanged and unverified. The later snapshot association is an explicit chronology blocker.

scopeNotes: The 2010 article’s 800 BCE to 100 CE range is identified as an approximate Ohio convention. The NPS page uses a broader Early Woodland interval, and Cowan Creek has a late, imprecise early radiocarbon determination. No uniform regional cutoff is inferred.
The central-grave organic dates are not direct dates on the stone pipe from burial 21.
Old excavation reports are evidence for recorded contexts, not reliable guides to Indigenous identity or status.
No authenticated writing system, royal office or single conquest is inferred.
The second imported map record has a documented chronology error requiring an importer or geometry correction before that map placement can be accepted.
